channel_id.desc: ID of the channel containing the agent session. Required for public channels.

icon_emoji.desc: Emoji to use as the agent's icon. Takes priority over `icon_url`. Remains in effect until you clear it (pass `null`) or set a new value. Requires the `chat:write.customize` scope. You can override the agent's icon and display name with the `icon_emoji`, `icon_url`, and `username` parameter.

icon_url.desc: URL to an image to use as the agent's icon. Remains in effect until you clear it (pass `null`) or set a new value. Requires the `chat:write.customize` scope. You can override the agent's icon and display name with the `icon_emoji`, `icon_url`, and `username` parameter.

initiator_user_id.desc: The user who initiated the session. Only used when creating a new session; ignored if the session already exists. Must be a member of the channel. The `title` and `initiator_user_id` arguments are applied only when the session is first created:

status.desc: The lifecycle status to set. _Acceptable values:_ `active` `processing` `suspended` `closed`

thread_ts.desc: Timestamp of the thread root message the session is scoped to. Required for thread-based sessions in regular channels and DMs. Must be omitted for session channels.

title.desc: Title for the agent session (max 200 characters). Only used when creating a new session; ignored if the session already exists. To rename an existing session, use `agents.sessions.rename`. The `title` and `initiator_user_id` arguments are applied only when the session is first created:

username.desc: Display name override for the agent (max 200 characters). Remains in effect until you clear it (pass `null`) or set a new value. Requires the `chat:write.customize` scope. You can override the agent's icon and display name with the `icon_emoji`, `icon_url`, and `username` parameter.

desc: Set an agent session's lifecycle status, creating the session if needed.

errors.channel_not_found: The specified channel does not exist or is not accessible.
errors.feature_disabled: The agent tasks feature is not enabled for this workspace.
errors.invalid_status: The `status` value is not a valid agent session status. Must be one of: `active`, `processing`, `suspended`, `closed`.
errors.not_authorized: The caller is not a member of the specified channel.
errors.thread_ts_not_allowed: `thread_ts` must not be provided for session channels. The channel-level session is updated automatically.
errors.thread_ts_required: `thread_ts` is required for thread-based sessions in regular channels and DMs.
errors.user_not_found: The specified `initiator_user_id` does not exist or is not accessible.
